newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris anti-terror alert a boon for bomb-town rats.
newsitem.headline: Paris anti-terror alert a boon for bomb-town rats.

text.p: A French security crackdown following a wave of bombings last year has given Paris rats a field day.
The newspaper Le Figaro said on Wednesday that the rodents had grown and bred faster than usual in rubbish piled on pavements as Paris police had ordered most of the city's 26,000 litter bins sealed.
City hall officials said a total of around 70 tonnes of litter piled up near the bins every day.
Last year's bombings, blamed on Algerian Moslem fundamentalists, killed eight people. Some bombs were placed in litter bins.
Authorities are gradually reopening all bins in the capital, including the most sensitive streets in the centre of the city.
